games.note: UCLA is 9-0 and back up to No. 4. Illinois is 6-3 and coming off a win over Nebraska, so a Friday night upset isn't out of the question.
No. 9 vs. No. 12. Duke jumped 13 spots last week and Miami fell 7 after losing at Notre Dame. With Wake Forest at No. 2, the loser falls well back in the ACC race.
Wake Forest moved up to No. 2 after beating Merrimack. A road trip to a 7-2 SMU team that just got back into my poll is a much bigger test.
Northwestern lost to Iowa and still moved into my poll at No. 25. Ohio State dropped out after losing to Oregon, so a home win would flip those two right back.
Tennessee is 7-2 after taking Kentucky apart 34-6. Texas A&M is only 4-5, but Kyle Field is still a tough place to go.
Indiana sat at No. 15 on its bye week. A 7-2 USC team, one of the best in my others receiving votes, is the chance to climb back up against a real opponent.
Missouri fell to No. 20 after losing to Texas. Georgia just beat Ole Miss 42-7 and doesn't have much reason to slow down.
Kentucky fell 14 spots after the blowout in Knoxville. Florida is 5-4 and just lost at home to Oklahoma, which makes this Kentucky's spot to bounce back.
Louisville is up to No. 14 after a 44-17 win at Georgia Tech. North Carolina is 5-4 and needs a win like this to stay on my list.
Both are in my others receiving votes. BYU is 7-2 after losing at Utah and Baylor is 6-3. The winner has the better case to get back into the top 25.
Minnesota lost to UCLA and Penn State beat Washington, so both are now 5-4. The loser is probably done in my others receiving votes.
Texas won at Missouri and still slid to No. 6. LSU fell 15 spots after losing to Alabama and gets another top-10 team in Death Valley at night.
No. 16 at No. 10, even though Texas Tech is 8-1 and Oklahoma State is 6-3. This one decides whether moving Oklahoma State up 13 spots was the right call.
Utah is 9-0 and up to No. 5 after beating BYU. A 7-2 Arizona team at home in a late kickoff is exactly where unbeaten seasons go to die.
This one got pushed to Sunday by the FAA ground stop. Ole Miss is coming off a 42-7 loss to Georgia and Oklahoma is coming off a win in Gainesville. Both teams are in my others receiving votes.
